name: KubeJS PneumaticCraft
description:
KubeJS integration for PneumaticCraft: Repressurized.

Write 11 PnC recipe types with event.recipes.pneumaticcraft.* instead of hand-written
event.custom JSON - and get a real error (with the list of legal keys) when a field is
wrong, instead of PnC silently ignoring it.

Recipe types: pressure_chamber, explosion_crafting, assembly_drill, assembly_laser,
fluid_mixer, refinery, thermo_plant, amadron, heat_frame_cooling, fuel_quality,
heat_properties.

Registers 11 PneumaticCraft-specific recipe components plus the pnc_set_field schema
function (.minTemp(373) / .maxTemp(333)).

Zero invasion: no mixins, no access transformers, no registry changes, no content -
it only registers recipe field types with KubeJS. Requires KubeJS and PneumaticCraft.

MIT. References no me.desht.pneumaticcraft.* classes: every rule was read out of PnC's
sources and re-implemented, so it neither inherits GPLv3 nor breaks when PnC internals change.

Octo Arms, a Create addon: the Tentacle Rig, a Backtank fitted with four pneumatic Tentacles.
Worn in the chest slot, it carries you over floors, walls and ceilings and lets you hang under ledges, powered by the Backtank's Air.
